MAINTENANCE
Aug 11, 2026
SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - AUGUST 13, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, August 13, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT (9:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM CEST / 11:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 6 hours, concluding around 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEST August 14).

Times:

Thursday, August 13, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 11:00 PM - 5:00 AM August 14

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.270.4.0.
List of issues fixed will be updated after maintenance has been completed.

items.body:
MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Aug 11, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE - AUGUST 11, 2026

[Updated 8/11 at 4:43 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed. Please restart your Nexon Launcher to ensure you receive the latest update.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance starting on Tuesday , August 11, 2026 at 4:00 PM PDT (7:00 PM EDT / 1:00 AM CEST August 12 / 9:00 AM AEST August 12). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 6:00 PM PDT (9:00 PM EDT / 3:00 AM CEST August 12 / 11:00 AM AEST August 12).

Times:

Tuesday, August 11, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 1:00 AM August 12 - 3:00 AM August 12
AEST (UTC +10): 9:00 AM August 12 - 11:00 AM August 12

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

Introducing new mobility skills brought a lot of design considerations as we aimed to balance them for various content planned for the future. At first, mobility skills were designed with cooldowns and lower MP costs. We are now shifting our approach to test skills with little to no cooldowns alongside higher MP costs, allowing us to evaluate different gameplay dynamics. As we continue to review performance data and your feedback, these skills may undergo further adjustments. Please give the updated skills a try and let us know what you think. The following Job Skills have been updated:

Fighter, Page, Spearman
Rush
Cooldown: 3 seconds → 1 second
MP Cost: (Lv. 1) 30 - (Lv. 20) 10 → (Lv. 1) 40 - (Lv. 20) 20
Ranger
Arrow Rain
Cooldown: 5 seconds → 0 second
Wind Step
Cooldown: 3 seconds → 1 second
MP Cost: (Lv. 1) 35 - (Lv. 20) 15 → (Lv. 1) 65 - (Lv. 20) 25
Sniper
Arrow Eruption
Cooldown: 5 seconds → 0 second
Evasion Step
Cooldown: 3 seconds → 1 second
MP Cost: (Lv. 1) 35 - (Lv. 20) 15 → (Lv. 1) 65 - (Lv. 20) 25
Hermit
Flash Jump
Cooldown: 3 seconds → 0 second
MP Cost: (Lv. 1) 60 - (Lv. 20) 20 → (Lv. 1) 70 - (Lv. 20) 30
Chief Bandit
Flash Jump
Cooldown: 3 seconds → 0 second
MP Cost: (Lv. 1) 60 - (Lv. 20) 20 → (Lv. 1) 70 - (Lv. 20) 30
Assaulter
Changed so the skill can be used while jumping.
Common
Increased the invincibility duration upon taking damage from 1 second → 1.5 seconds
Resolved an issue where Magic Armor at Lv.8 consumed 68 MP instead of 10 MP.
Resolved an issue where Rush at Lv. 6 did not move the character when used.
Resolved an issue where changing channels while Dragon Blood was active would drain the characters HP by 99%.
items.bodyZh: 维护 经典 2026年8月11日 [已完成] 预定维护 - 2026年8月11日 [更新于8月11日下午4:43 PDT] 维护已完成。请重启您的Nexon启动器以确保获得最新更新。 我们将于2026年8月11日星期二下午4:00 PDT（晚上7:00 EDT / 8月12日凌晨1:00 CEST / 8月12日上午9:00 AEST）开始进行预定维护。预计维护将持续约2小时，大约在下午6:00 PDT（晚上9:00 EDT / 8月12日凌晨3:00 CEST / 8月12日上午11:00 AEST）结束。 时间详情： 2026年8月11日，星期二 * 北京时间 (UTC +8): 8月12日 上午7:00 - 上午9:00 * 太平洋夏令时 (UTC -7): 下午4:00 - 下午6:00 * 东部夏令时 (UTC -4): 晚上7:00 - 晚上9:00 * 中欧夏令时 (UTC +2): 8月12日 凌晨1:00 - 8月12日 凌晨3:00 * 澳大利亚东部标准时间 (UTC +10): 8月12日 上午9:00 - 8月12日 上午11:00 将不可用的内容： 所有MapleStory经典世界游戏服务器。 更改与更新： 引入新的移动技能带来了许多设计考量，我们旨在平衡它们以适应未来计划的各种内容。起初，移动技能设计为带有冷却时间和较低的MP消耗。我们现在正在转变方法，测试几乎没有冷却时间但MP消耗更高的技能，以便评估不同的游戏动态。随着我们继续审查性能数据和您的反馈，这些技能可能会进行进一步调整。请尝试更新后的技能并告诉我们您的想法。以下职业技能已更新： 战士、骑士、枪战士 冲锋 冷却时间：3秒 → 1秒 MP消耗：(1级) 30 - (20级) 10 → (1级) 40 - (20级) 20 弓箭手 箭雨 冷却时间：5秒 → 0秒 风之步 冷却时间：3秒 → 1秒 MP消耗：(1级) 35 - (20级) 15 → (1级) 65 - (20级) 25 狙击手 箭矢爆发 冷却时间：5秒 → 0秒 闪避步 冷却时间：3秒 → 1秒 MP消耗：(1级) 35 - (20级) 15 → (1级) 65 - (20级) 25 隐士 二段跳 冷却时间：3秒 → 0秒 MP消耗：(1级) 60 - (20级) 20 → (1级) 70 - (20级) 30 侠盗 二段跳 冷却时间：3秒 → 0秒 MP消耗：(1级) 60 - (20级) 20 → (1级) 70 - (20级) 30 突击者 已更改，使技能可以在跳跃时使用。 通用 受到伤害时的无敌时间从1秒增加到1.5秒。 修复了8级魔法护甲消耗68 MP而非10 MP的问题。 修复了6级冲锋使用时角色不移动的问题。 修复了龙血激活时切换频道会导致角色HP减少99%的问题。
